name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for accessibility upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for accessibility upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for accessibility upgrades, prioritize experience with similar projects and a strong understanding of local accessibility standards. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor. Review their portfolio, ask for references, and ensure they communicate clearly about project scope, timeline, and costs. A good contractor will also help you explore appropriate solutions for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience in accessibility projects, knowledge of local standards, and clear communication.
